questions.prompt: Where should the Antigravity port be housed in this repository?
questions.description: Per AGENTS.md, foreign harness ports isolate their deltas in `harness/<name>/` (e.g. `harness/mistral-vibe/`) so upstream Claude Code plugin files at the root remain clean and mergeable.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Isolate in harness/antigravity/ (mirrors harness/mistral-vibe/; root stays untouched).

options.label: Isolate in harness/antigravity/ (mirrors harness/mistral-vibe/; root stays untouched)
Dual-home at repository root (add Antigravity files alongside Claude Code files)

questions.prompt: How should the `rubyist` orchestrator be configured and dispatch the 5 phase subagents in Antigravity?
questions.description: In Antigravity CLI (`agy`), sessions can be launched with `--agent <name>`. Subagents can be dispatched using `invoke_subagent` (referencing agent types). In addition, `rubyist` must never edit `.rb` files directly.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Dual mode: deploy rubyist orchestrator profile for `agy --agent rubyist`, which dispatches the 5 phase subagents (specifier, implementer, cleaner, hardener, verifier) via invoke_subagent, with define_subagent fallback.

options.label: Dual mode: rubyist agent profile using invoke_subagent with define_subagent fallback for the 5 phase agents
Strict invoke_subagent only (assumes all 5 phase agents are pre-registered via the plugin)
Single-agent collapse (orchestrator executes all 5 phases sequentially in one context)

questions.prompt: How should workflow commands (`/ruby-development` and `/ruby-gate`) be mapped to Antigravity?
questions.description: Antigravity has deprecated `.agents/workflows/` in favor of skills (`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`). In `harness/mistral-vibe`, commands were mapped to user-invocable skills.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Map as user-invocable skills (skills/ruby-development/SKILL.md and skills/ruby-gate/SKILL.md) inside the plugin.

options.label: Inline command logic into rubyist orchestrator prompt only (no separate skills)
Map as skills and add routing shortcuts to rules/AGENTS.md

questions.prompt: How should upstream `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` and relative file links be resolved for Antigravity?
questions.description: Upstream agent prompts and skills use `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` to locate role skills, shared conventions (`references/`), and task files. In Antigravity plugins, assets reside in the plugin directory.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Relative Markdown links + plugin-root fallback instructions (works both globally in ~/.gemini/config/plugins and locally in .agents/plugins).

options.label: Relative Markdown links + plugin-root fallback instructions (works globally & locally)

questions.prompt: How should non-stdlib gem API verification be specified in Antigravity prompts?
questions.description: Upstream specifies verifying non-stdlib gem APIs via Context7 MCP or DeepWiki. In Antigravity CLI, both Context7 and DeepWiki are available MCP servers (or web search fallback).
questions.recommendedAnswer: Reference Context7 / DeepWiki MCP tools with search_web fallback.

options.label: Reference Context7 / DeepWiki MCP tools with search_web fallback

questions.prompt: What installation and validation tooling should be included with the port?
questions.description: To ensure the port works out of the box and does not regress, we can include automated checks and installation helpers.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Install script (global and project-local), `agy plugin validate` validation, cleanliness grep check, and rubyist agent profile installer.

options.label: Install script supporting both global (~/.gemini/config/plugins/ruby-dev) and project-local (.agents/plugins/ruby-dev)
Automated grep check for untranslated Claude tokens (${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, claude --agent, Agent()
Helper to link/copy rubyist.md to ~/.gemini/agents/ for `agy --agent rubyist`
